def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs["n"]  # number of people
    k = inputs["k"]  # every k-th person is eliminated
    
    # Josephus problem
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Count k positions (wrapping around)
        current = (current + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current)
        # After removal, current index now points to the next person
        if current == len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
